**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

The agreement is silent on Customer-payable stipulated amounts:

- **§ 3 (Compensation)** — time-and-materials fees, out-of-pocket expenses and taxes only; no late-payment interest, penalty or forfeiture mechanic.
- **§ 6 (Termination)** and the duplicate **§ 7(c)** — on termination for convenience or for cause, Contractor is paid only "all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned … through the effective date of such termination." That is accrued consideration, not an early-termination fee or minimum commitment.
- **§ 7(a)–(b)** — mutual liability caps and consequential damages waiver; no stipulated-damages language in either direction.
- Text searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "stipulated", "minimum" and "forfeit" returned no hits.

This sits at the **preferred** position, so no redline was proposed.
